column3: AX-200 Data Sheet · Rev. C · March 2026
The AX-200 is a digital temperature sensor with an I2C interface and a 12-bit resolution. It operates from 2.7 V to
5.5 V and draws less than 250 µA in active mode. An open-drain alert output signals when the temperature crosses a programmable limit.
Unless otherwise noted, limits apply at VDD = 3.3 V and an ambient temperature of 25 °C.
